main.description: A post in a thread: a thread's opening post, a chat message, a forum reply or a comment on an article alike. Written by its author. A thread's opening post (OP) is its author's first post in it that answers no other post. A channel's untitled chat is the posts whose thread is the channel's own thread record.

thread.description: What this post belongs to: a community.lexicon.thread.thread, or any site.standard.document when the post is a comment on an article.

replyTo.description: The post this one answers, if any. Apps may show replies flat (forum, chat) or nested (comments).

document.description: A site.standard.document that is the same piece of writing, such as a thread's opening post that is also a blog post, or a long reply republished as an article. Only counts when the document is in the same repo and links back with community.lexicon.thread.defs#link.

textContent.description: Plain-text rendering of the post. Required, so every reader can show every post. Should not contain markdown or other formatting.

content.description: The post in an app-native format. Open union.

updatedAt.description: When the post was last edited.
